purpose: Define a minimal prediction-facing Layer-B v2 representation that removes node-static support signatures and retains only pre-outcome context-to-reference change.

motivating_frozen_evidence.tampa_posthoc: static node-level Layer-B was reused across repeated visits and became a unique geometry/topology signature under a saturated world set
motivating_frozen_evidence.known_truth_factorial: static repeated state had positive median log-loss penalty; arbitrary label-dependent source also harmed; generator-shift positive-median hypothesis was refuted

input.reference: one source-symmetric prediction-facing summary computed from the declared initial pre-outcome context
input.current: source-symmetric prediction-facing summary computed from evidence available strictly before the scored current context

transform.feature_names: prefix each source-symmetric feature with delta_from_reference__
transform.static_offset_invariance: adding the same arbitrary node-by-feature static offset to reference and current must leave output unchanged
transform.world_or_source_label_invariance: inherited from source-symmetric input; prediction fingerprint must not depend on source/world labels

prediction_semantics.interpretation: change in the prediction-facing world-set support state since a fixed pre-outcome reference, not absolute geometry, occupancy probability, movement probability, or world truth
prediction_semantics.current_outcome_access: forbidden before current features are computed
prediction_semantics.reference_outcome_access: reference must be fixed using only information admissible before the first scored context

known_truth_tests: identical static states map exactly to zero
source/world renaming and ordering do not change innovation when source-symmetric inputs are equivalent
forbidden_interpretations: The innovation representation has been shown to improve prediction in Tampa or any fresh ecological endpoint
The transform changes or repairs the frozen Tampa result
The transform changes Layer A or the closed EOG-WF favorable/favorable/adverse synthesis
A zero innovation means ecological stasis rather than no change in the declared prediction-facing structural representation
